item.text: {"prompt":"Create a square, full-bleed nonrepresentational abstract painting that conveys a mind holding many competing signals at once. Build a dense, restless core of layered marks in deep ultramarine, charcoal, and bruised violet, cut through by sudden threads and smears of hot coral, acid yellow, and cold white. Let the brushwork alternate between tight, repeated strokes and broad, scraped gestures; stack translucent washes over dry, rough textures, with areas of abrasion and pigment buildup. Give the composition an uneven rhythm and spatial tension: compressed, high-contrast activity gathering off-center, interrupted by a few open passages of near-black and quiet, thinly veiled color. Keep the energy unresolved, shifting between coherence and interruption, with no single focal mark dominating. Purely abstract painting only: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. The painting fills the entire square image edge to edge, with no frame, border, wall, room, or gallery setting."}
